measures.what: outer diameter (measure across the outer race at two perpendicular angles, avoiding the pinch points)
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.what: mounting tab hole spacing (distance between the centres of the two mounting holes on the tab flange, measured end to end)
measures.reply: servo tab holes: 4.58 mm (each mounting tab has two holes, open to the tab's end like a U); servo hole spacing: 44.61 mm (between the holes on the two tabs, from the inside edge of one to the inside edge of the other; I didn't measure the spacing between the two holes on one tab)

measures.what: body width and height (the short dimension and the body depth, excluding tabs)
measures.reply: servo body width: 19.82 mm (the case, side to side); servo body height: 40.4 mm (the case, top to bottom)

measures.what: horn diameter, and the centre-to-centre distance of the screw holes nearest the spline
measures.reply: servo tab holes: 4.58 mm (each mounting tab has two holes, open to the tab's end like a U); servo hole spacing: 44.61 mm (between the holes on the two tabs, from the inside edge of one to the inside edge of the other; I didn't measure the spacing between the two holes on one tab); servo spline: 5.84 mm (the output shaft, across its splines, where an arm would grip it; there's a smaller reading of 5.60 at the very top, and I'm not sure which feature that was); servo horns: four plastic horns came with it (a double arm, a six-arm star, a round disc and a cross), and I bought a 25-tooth aluminium single arm (the aluminium arm's hub is 14.66 across and 5.95 thick, the arm 3.86 thick, 34.62 from the hub's far edge to the tip, with 2.55 holes; I didn't measure where the holes are, or the plastic horns)

measures.what: depth from the mounting tab plane to the bottom of the case (the dimension perpendicular to the tabs, not including the output shaft)
measures.reply: servo spline: 5.84 mm (the output shaft, across its splines, where an arm would grip it; there's a smaller reading of 5.60 at the very top, and I'm not sure which feature that was)

measures.what: distance from the hub centre to each of the 2.55 mm holes along the arm, and the hole spacing if there are two or more
measures.reply: servo tab holes: 4.58 mm (each mounting tab has two holes, open to the tab's end like a U); servo hole spacing: 44.61 mm (between the holes on the two tabs, from the inside edge of one to the inside edge of the other; I didn't measure the spacing between the two holes on one tab); servo horns: four plastic horns came with it (a double arm, a six-arm star, a round disc and a cross), and I bought a 25-tooth aluminium single arm (the aluminium arm's hub is 14.66 across and 5.95 thick, the arm 3.86 thick, 34.62 from the hub's far edge to the tip, with 2.55 holes; I didn't measure where the holes are, or the plastic horns)
